summary: Eni S.p.A., via Form 6-K, reported treasury share purchases from July 27–31, 2026, under its second tranche buyback program approved May 6, 2026. The issuer acquired 4,971,860 shares (0.16% of share capital) at a weighted average price of €23.1302 per share, totaling ~€115 million, on Euronext Milan. Since program start on May 8, 2026, Eni bought 48,612,710 shares (1.61%) for ~€1.075 billion, accumulating 4.47% of share capital. The buyback funds additional shareholder remuneration beyond dividends, executing on-market with no premium or tender mechanics; watch ongoing purchases and program pace.
